narration: You think buying in bulk saves money. Scientists ran the math — and bulk buyers actually spend $1,800 more per year, not less.
visual: Dark background. Shopping cart SVG loaded with oversized boxes and bottles. '$1,800 MORE' badge springs in red. 'Feels Like Saving' text appears with strikethrough.

narration: Wharton researchers proved a full pantry switches off your brain's restraint. You start consuming 30% faster — because the stuff is just there.
visual: Light background. Packed pantry shelf SVG springs in, overflowing with items. A percentage counter animates from 0% to 30% in red below the shelf.

narration: What you don't consume faster, you throw out. Bulk households waste 40% more food than targeted shoppers — real dollars in your trash can.
visual: Dark background. Trash can SVG pops in. Three food items — old bread, wilted veggie, expired can — fall in one by one. Dollar counter climbs to $2,080.

narration: Add the membership fee, the impulse buys, and wasted food — the average bulk shopper ends up $1,800 in the hole every single year.
visual: Light background. Receipt-style card reveals three line items: Club Membership $147, Impulse Buys $800, Food Wasted $853. 'TOTAL DAMAGE: $1,800' springs in at the bottom.

narration: The wild part? You feel smarter every time you do it. Your brain gives you a 'good saver' badge — while your wallet quietly empties.
visual: Dark background. Brain SVG with gold star badge on left versus wallet SVG with dollars flying out on right. 'Brain VS Wallet' layout. 'The savings aren't real' fades in.

narration: Only buy non-perishables in bulk, and always use a list. Treat bulk shopping like a tool, not a habit — and you'll keep that $1,800.
visual: Light background. Two green checklist items spring in: 'NON-PERISHABLES ONLY' and 'ALWAYS USE A LIST'. Piggy bank SVG grows in. '$1,800 SAVED' badge pops in green.
